title: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at Nov 23 board meeting

title: Target reports strongest quarterly sales gain in five years heading into the holiday shopping season
summary: Target reported a 7.1% increase in net sales for the third quarter, reaching $27.07 billion. The growth was attributed to a revitalized product lineup, expanded same-day deliveries, and price cuts. CEO Michael Fiddelke indicated that the sales momentum was observed across various income groups. The company aims to enhance clothing and home goods offerings while working on women's apparel and footwear.

summary: Gateway Distriparks Limited has gained a mandate for operating the common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. The contract spans eight years, focusing on train handling, container stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. Gateway aims to work closely with JNPA to improve rail connectivity for trade.

The location in Narasapura is strategically chosen for its connectivity to Bengaluru's markets.

title: Real estate firm Assetz gets Sebi nod to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO

With strong backing from investors like AGP Partners, the firm is expanding its presence in key markets.
